name: bq-social-contributions
description: Analyse 2026 statutory contributions in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for AOV, AWW, healthcare, employee insurance, cessantia, self-employed income, contribution ceilings and annual reconciliation. Establishes separate insured-person and employer charges, the taxable-sum base, insurance exclusions, tax credits and remittance evidence. Includes primary legislation, annual resident examples and separate employer wage calculations. Distinguishes contribution ceilings from benefit limits and annual assessment from payroll withholding. This source-cited draft holds unverified partial-year, overseas, voluntary, special-status, rounding and return-mapping branches. Load with the social contributions workflow base and the relevant income or payroll guide. It does not authorise filing or payment.
